name: Xu Yongge
bio: Graduated from Shandong Academy of Arts, Cantonese Drama Faculty, in 1987.

credits.title: Tales of the Blood Moon
credits.overview: Under the cursed glow of the blood moon, a forgotten warrior rises to challenge the empire of shadows. With only ancient martial techniques and a prophecy to guide him, he must restore balance before the darkness consumes all.

credits.title: Love is a Tender Illusion
credits.overview: At the airport, Lei Peng met a gentle girl who was highly similar to his ex-girlfriend, and he also met Shu Dai, a strange man who tried to match them up. The two parties reached a contract to "pretend to be a couple". A series of sweet and funny farce unfolded. It’s all calm, what's wrong, an astonishing truth surface

credits.title: Snowfall
credits.overview: A story concerning the Chinese peasants during the transition period, and the victims of the economic wave during the period of China's reform and opening up.

credits.title: The Ex-File 3: The Return of the Exes
credits.overview: Buddies Meng Yun and Yu Fei break up with their girlfriends and indulge themselves in living the bachelor lifestyle again.  However, as their ex-girlfriends reemerge in their lives, their “Single Plan” starts to unravel!

credits.title: Guards On Railroads
credits.overview: In the north in the 1990s, the passengers on the train were suddenly robbed by armed bandits.  Railway criminal police Tie Wei and others fought life and death with the car bandits.  This gang of car bandits is known as the Flying Tiger Gang.
